author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
How are museum exhibits designed and prototyped? At the Academy Museum, Adam visits the exhibition design studio to learn from Exhibition Design Director Laura Belevica about her process working with curators to create immersive spaces that showcase filmmakers and the artifacts of film production. 

Learn more about the Academy Museum and its collection at https://www.academymuseum.org/ and https://www.academycollection.org/
Learn more about the Academy Library at https://www.oscars.org/library

Shot by Joey Fameli and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
